description: Appends a timestamped 'via AI' note by default

confirm.description: Set to true to commit writes, false to preview

confirmReplace.description: Must be set to true if mode is "replace" to confirm overriding existing notes.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique key to prevent duplicate edits

mode.description: Mode to edit notes: "append" (timestamped suffix) or "replace" (overwrite). Defaults to "append".

orderId.description: The order document ID to update
